# Battery Cell Performance Characterization - Test Dataset B02

## 1. Operating Specifications and Protocol
This experimental report documents the electrochemical cycling, thermal behavior, and
operational parameters for commercial lithium-ion test cells evaluated under laboratory validation protocols.

The accompanying protocol description refers to the temperature field but does not state whether the values are measured instrument readings or placeholders.
The data dictionary specifies that the charge capacity counter resets at the beginning of every step.
The deposit stores only instantaneous snapshots of the voltage; interval-based sampling-point semantics do not arise.
Documentation states that current intervals include both endpoints.
An index-related column exists for the step index; the precise encoding scheme that recovers the index is not stated.

Baseline environmental chamber temperature was maintained at 25.0 C across all test runs.

### 1.1 Detailed Instrumentation and Channel Mapping
Galvanostatic cycling was conducted using an automated multi-channel battery test system.

Channel voltages were calibrated against secondary standards prior to dataset acquisition.

Within the dataset the charge/discharge state is determined by exclusively: step_type_column.
No current channel is present in this deposit configuration; unit declarations for that signal therefore do not apply.
Laboratory documentation states the current scale factor is identity (none).

## 2. Archival Summary and End of Report
Validation dataset B02 concluded without hardware interrupt flags.

---
End of Report B02.
